environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'backend' with default NetworkPolicy (allow-all). The gRPC port 50051 is exposed via a ClusterIP service. No sidecar proxy. Pod runs with default service account. Secrets mounted from a Kubernetes Secret object with rotation handled by external-secrets-operator syncing from AWS Secrets Manager every 60 seconds. The diagnostic endpoint (GetHeapDump) is accessible to any client that can reach the gRPC port. No mTLS configured.
